profile.headline: Software Engineer at Boeing
profile.summary: A software engineer in Arlington, VA who likes to make creative solutions for open-ended problems.

positions.title: Software Engineer L2
positions.description:
-Develops, maintains, and documents the frontend interface for a next-generation satellite operator system
-Interfaces directly with integration teams, gathering requirements, fielding feature requests, and solving outstanding issues or addressing gaps
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Node.js · HTML5 · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JavaScript

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Current Project (Jan 2022-Present): Boeing satellite interface development
Development of a modern web interface in React that allows easy and intuitive satellite fleet commanding and monitoring.
positions.insights: Skills: Redux.js · Web Interface Design · Material-UI · Web Development · React.js · JavaScript

positions.title: Oystar Software Developer
positions.description:
• Designing college-side of a platform that matches international students to academic opportunities in the U.S. 
• Programming, testing, and deploying React JS front-end and Firebase backend

positions.title: Quarantine Narratives Project Developer
positions.description: • Utilized React JS, HTML, and CSS to help create a responsive and dynamic website that allows users to upload and view text, voice recordings, and pictures about how quarantine in the era of COVID-19 has impacted their lives

positions.title: DSC Project Manager
positions.description:
• Partnered with free health clinic, the Saturday Neighborhood Health Clinic, to create a fast, extensible, and beautiful Python dashboard for grant writers and employees interested in their positive impact on undeserved communities
• Maintaining, guiding, and assessing dashboard development

positions.title: Head Of Software Development--Sunshine Project
positions.description:
•Programming and creating assets for a mobile app that turns medication and habit tracking into a video game, rewarding people who may suffer with mental health problems for tasks such as taking their medicine, exercising, or meeting their own personal goals
•Development responsibilities include game functionality, lighting, camera-work, item interactions, and events

positions.title: Machine Learning Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
•Guide students through the theory and mathematics of machine learning
•Help students to better understand and complete real machine learning algorithms and proofs

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Teaching Assistant for Washington St. Louis's Technical Writing and Engineering Leadership Courses
•	Revising and creating course materials, assignments, and course assignments 
•      Helping young engineers to communicate clearly with other engineers, businesspeople, and users

positions.title: Front Desk Representative
positions.description:
• Worked with medical record systems to schedule appointments, bill, and check patient information
• Addressed patient concerns
• Helped to coordinate interaction between doctor and patient to make the healthcare experience as pleasant as possible

positions.title: Designer
positions.description: Worked as a team member and designer on myEHR, a student startup that aimed to connect the 1,300 different health record programs used across the world to each other, making record transfer smooth, safe, and hassle-free.

positions.title: Sustainability Intern
positions.description:
Sustainability intern to make Culver Academies and its operations more sustainable.
• Performed comprehensive waste audit on all of Culver's operations
• Rehabilitated wetland barrier to reduce pollution for local animals and children
• Assisted with prairie rehabilitation project to restore one of the only patches of natural prairie in Marshall County
• Created campaigns and videos to inspire Culver students and staff to practice recycling
